corrections_applied: hardware/docs/Research.md: two edits below the status line are reverted, because P7 may change only the status line there. They were the GaN expansion in the Held parts table and the TLP expansion in the V12 answer.

Comparisons that no verified return backs with a figure now state the rank alone. Control.md: the crystal ('rank 1; meets every value of V5, V6, V7 and V15'), the OR gate, the trigger-path inverter and SN74LVC1G04DBVR ('rank 1 of the inverters read, on propagation delay and stock'); the unverified 4.2 ns re-rank figure is removed. Supply.md: the 3.3 V buck, the 5 V rail, both motor shunts ('rank 1 on accuracy: its path error is 0.50 A of 1.5 A at 150 A' and '0.73 A of 3 A at 300 A') and the port shunt. Sensing.md: the cell monitor, TCA9548APWR, ADS1235IRHBR and BD450M2FP3-CE2.

Where a return contradicts a statement in the specification, the contradiction is now stated as not known with both sources, and the specification text is left unchanged. Control.md, the latch's place: IOBoard.md Latch says it is not stated; FU-A3 found V30, confirmed in FU-A3/015. Control.md, the receiver input count: IOBoard.md Receiver inputs says it is not stated; FU-A3/010 confirms V68 = 1. Supply.md, the port monitor sample rate: IOBoard.md says it is not stated; V173 gives 5 ms.
Each of the 25 figure bullets under Not verified on Control.md, Supply.md and Sensing.md now reads '; not verified' on its own line.

Parts.md: S, Q and V question IDs, P4 and the FU- runs are now defined. The provenance sentence now names its one exception: the placements of SN74LVC1G04DBVR add the counts of two verifiers, as the cross-category check does. 'no alternate was found' now reads 'no alternate is known'.

IOBoard.md: FU- runs are now defined in the key paragraph. The meaning of 'required' in the state table no longer contradicts lines that name a round 1 part. The duplicated '(R2)' on Link to the display is removed. Port current monitor's state now starts with 'required;'. The ESC pack protection bullet now says in its own sentence that no part qualifies as the clamp. The ADC-input bullet no longer claims more than P5's count states.
STATUS.md: P4 is named as the verifiers' phase in the three group rows. The Open intro now says only its first nine rows come from round 1 and go to the owner.
Control.md and Supply.md are in present tense: 'or its part is not requalified' and 'both held or fixed inputs, and both refuted'.

An earlier P7-critic session in the same scratch directory left corrections in the tree. This session re-checked them against the returns and kept them. They are: TPSI3052DWZR placements '4 (2 a path, the top of 1 to 2, on the onboard and the external path)'; RP2354B's Digi-Key part in backticks; acronym expansions (SMD, HTTP, VGS(th), RDS(on), VBUS, CC, BENCH, DC, TI); the key-term paragraph on each group page; the Parts.md intro on library type and categories; full alternates lists (SN74LV244APWR and 74LV244APWJ, both LTC6813 parts); and sources for the VESC and GPIO not-known items.

jlc_stock_review.reason: check_jlc calls jlc_exact(row.lcsc) at line 273 for every selected row that has an LCSC number (called at 357). It reads the alternate's LCSC at 283. It reads each row of the 'Alternates and Q options' table that is not read yet at 364, and the held row at 387. The build quantity is the positional argument 'boards' (409), passed to gate().

jlc_exact walks the result list and returns only the row whose componentCode equals the LCSC number, ignoring case. When no row matches it reports 'no exact match' (152) rather than taking the first result.
gate() returns max(5 x boards x placements, 50), which is S4's rule applied to the need. rule4() at 257 adds canPresaleNumber >= 0. Together these are sourcing rule 4.

A missing exact match comes back as an error from jlc_exact (152) and becomes a [FAIL] line through rep.fail at 275. The same happens at 285, 366 and 389 for alternates, option rows and held rows. main() returns 1 under --check when any [FAIL] was counted (417).

When the part fails rule 4 and its alternate fails too, shortfalls() prints '[FAIL] PART: stock N, gate G' and/or '[FAIL] PART: presale N' for the alternate (293) and for the part (302). A part without an alternate fails the same way. Each [FAIL] counts, so --check exits 1.
When rule 4 fails and alt_ok is true, the tool prints '[warn] PART fails rule 4 and its alternate ALT passes'. No [FAIL] line and no count follow.

check_digikey is called for every row whose Second source starts with 'Digi-Key' and for every row without an LCSC number, the part off the board (358-359). The held row is also checked, at 400. For a part off the board it queries the part and its alternate (322-336). DigiKey() takes DIGIKEY_CLIENT_ID and DIGIKEY_CLIENT_SECRET from the environment (156-157), with DIGIKEY_ENV_FILE as a fallback, and never prints them.

For an on-board row, a Digi-Key stock under the row's gate prints '[FAIL] PART (second vendor): stock N, gate G' (314). For a part off the board, the part or its alternate under the gate prints '[FAIL] MPN: stock N, gate G' (333). Both count toward exit 1. The two 'not selected' Q-option rows are reported as [warn], since they are not parts of the build.

Without credentials DigiKey.stock returns the error 'no Digi-Key credentials'. Each such row then prints '[FAIL] PART: second vendor not checked, ...' (312), or '[FAIL] MPN: not checked, ...' for a part off the board (330). The run also prints 'its rows are not checked' (348), and the [FAIL] lines make --check exit 1.

Rows whose Held column starts with a number are collected apart (352-354). They are printed under 'Personal library (rule 6):'. Each passes when held >= boards x placements, and the line includes '(stated DATE)' taken from the Held cell (79-80). A shortfall is a [FAIL] (396).
The docstring states 'Run by hand before an order, not in CI (continuous integration): a stock count moving is not a defect in the tree'. No workflow under .github references tools/jlc_stock.py.
